title: CallLint Safe-Install Result
description: The machine-readable result envelope (calllint.safe-install-result.v1) emitted by the `calllint safe-install` orchestrator and the MCP adoption tools (new14 Phase 2.4; ADR 0056 §9). Reports the OUTCOME of a local, exact-target adoption attempt — it delegates every live write to the shipped Trust Gateway apply service (the one writer; INV-2.4-03) and carries no verdict of its own (INV-2.4-01). `outcome` is a closed vocabulary; `receiptDigest`/`planDigest` bind the result to the shipped install-plan + decision-receipt objects (never a parallel 'safe-install plan' type; §4.1). One-time mode leaves zero persistent CallLint files (INV-2.4-07); persistentComponents is empty unless a separate, explicit continuous-protection authorization was granted.

schema.description: Wire identity. The tag, not the filename, is the contract (ADR 0043/0055 §5).

outcome.description: Closed outcome vocabulary. ABORTED_ON_MISMATCH = an exact-target digest/version assertion failed → no writable plan was produced (INV-2.4-06). DECLINED = the operator did not approve at the single approval gate.

canonicalName.description: The canonical tool identity this result concerns.

mode.description: The adoption mode. Default is ONE_TIME_PROTECTED_SETUP, which MUST NOT install any persistent CallLint component (INV-2.4-07).

host.description: The resolved host id when an apply was attempted; null for prepare-only / unsupported.

version.description: The exact version acted on. null only when the outcome is LOCAL_PREFLIGHT_REQUIRED / UNSUPPORTED.

planDigest.description: Digest of the shipped calllint.install-plan.v1 that was applied (null unless APPLIED_AND_VERIFIED).

receiptDigest.description: Digest of the shipped decision-receipt emitted by the apply service (null unless a write occurred).

persistentComponents.description: Persistent CallLint components installed. MUST be empty in ONE_TIME_PROTECTED_SETUP mode (audited; INV-2.4-07). Each entry is enumerated with its documented uninstall command in the human transcript.

notes.description: Human-readable, non-decision notes (e.g. why a slot is empty, and the decision-relay sentences an agent may echo). Never carries publisher content, and never a decision: each sentence is wording plus a field read off the sealed contract, and a sentence whose field is absent is omitted rather than softened (ADR 0058 §6 — relay copy may never add or remove a protocol trigger).

tool.description: The MCP tool that emitted this envelope (e.g. calllint_prepare_safe_install). Absent on the CLI's own result, which has no tool identity. DECLARED at P-6: the MCP surface has emitted this since Batch 6, so a schema that forbade it described something the code does not do (the same defect class as a key that validates and does nothing). Declaring is the honest fix — dropping the field would change published MCP output.

note.description: The singular no-write / apply-provenance disclosure sentence. Distinct from `notes`: this is one fixed statement about what the tool did NOT do, not a list. Carries no verdict.

receipt.description: The shipped calllint.decision-receipt.v1 emitted by the apply service, carried verbatim so a caller can re-verify the apply later. Emitted only on the apply path. Opaque here — the receipt has its own schema and is never re-serialized by this envelope.

configPath.description: The host config file the apply engine actually wrote. Emitted only on the apply path; never a guessed location (INV-2.4-04).

configDigestBefore.description: Digest of the host config before the write, or the literal "absent" when no file existed. Emitted only on the apply path.

configDigestAfter.description: Digest of the host config after the write; null when no durable write survived (including after a rollback). Emitted only on the apply path.

backupPath.description: The backup the apply engine took before writing; null when there was no pre-existing file to back up. Emitted only on the apply path.

rolledBack.description: Whether verification failed and the engine restored the backup. Emitted only on the apply path. A true value means no CallLint change survived.
